cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only closing up. Before you go, could you check the window latch? I'll leave that one till you've tried it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll draw the curtain first, then. Why's it moving if the window's shut? Could you have a look?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll have the fan off before we finish. Could you show me which switch? I'll leave the others alone till you've pointed it out.

reason: Give S06 a modest concrete role that determines task order, terms, timing or information handling. Keep exact Drive and B successive contributions; preserve all source and original evidence.
